metadata.title: Vintage Instant Film Portrait with Marker Lettering

retrievalProfile.description: A square instant-film portrait featuring a cropped subject and thick, hand-written marker text on the bottom white border.
triggerTerms: polaroid style portrait with marker writing
instant film aesthetic with hand-drawn initials
vintage photo with white border and felt-tip pen text

recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format photograph with a wide white border, mimicking instant film. The image is a soft-focus, slightly overexposed portrait of a person from the chest up, wearing a graphic sweatshirt. The bottom border contains thick, dark blue hand-lettered characters that appear to be written with a permanent marker.
coreVisualRelationships: The white border frames the central square image symmetrically on three sides with a larger bottom margin.
The hand-lettered text is anchored to the bottom white margin, balancing the visual weight of the portrait.
The soft, pastel tones of the photograph contrast with the dark, saturated ink of the marker lettering.
coreInvariants: Square image aspect ratio within a rectangular white frame.
Thick, uneven marker-style lettering on the bottom border.
Soft-focus, low-contrast photographic style with warm skin tones.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered, cropped at the chin and mid-torso, filling the majority of the square frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red lips and the dark marker text at the bottom serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red lips, moves down to the graphic on the sweatshirt, and finally rests on the bold lettering in the margin.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The wide white border acts as significant negative space, emphasizing the 'found object' quality of the photo.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and cream tones in the border and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted lavender and blue in the sweatshirt graphic.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated red on the lips and dark navy blue for the marker text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation and high value in the photo, contrasted by high saturation and low value in the text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to muted pastels and one or two bold accents

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width consistent with a felt-tip marker
Rounded terminals and visible ink pooling at stroke ends
Slightly irregular baseline and character spacing
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerals have a slight lean and simplified forms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single hand-written style to maintain the 'personal artifact' aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the thick, felt-tip stroke and rounded ends.
Captures the ink-bleed and casual nature of the lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square, soft-focus vintage portrait of a person in a graphic sweatshirt, centered within a wide white instant-film frame with a larger bottom margin.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-written marker lettering in dark navy blue to the bottom white margin, ensuring a casual, slightly irregular appearance.

verificationChecks: Is the image square within a rectangular white frame?
Does the text look like it was written with a physical marker?
Is the photo quality soft and slightly overexposed?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is confined to the bottom margin.
Ensure the photo has a visible grain and soft focus.
Verify the marker strokes have rounded, organic ends.
Confirm the aspect ratio of the inner image is 1:1.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square vintage portrait + white polaroid frame + bottom-aligned marker lettering.
